This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

This 
pump operate in the condensate polishing system, acid metering pump is required 
for regeneration of the cation resin and caustic metering pump is required for 
regeneration of the anion resin
